description: Inundação (dados de Ocorrências) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Registros de pontos de inundação referentes as ocorrências da Defesa Civil (ano 2026) extraídos do Sistema Integrado de Gestão do Relacionamento com o Cidadão (SIGRC). Os dados da série histórica (de 2013 até a presente data) estão disponíveis para download. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Meio Físico, Desastres, geoscientificInformation. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
